method: membrane-kv-runtime-relocate-probe 'multi' mode: relocate layer 4 (first move away from shared CPU bulk buffer), then layer 5 (also first move), both CPU->GPU, in ONE live context, no free triggered by either (both are first moves for their respective layers).
conclusion: Relocating two DIFFERENT layers (each once) works cleanly, no crash. Supports the finding that the problematic lifecycle is specific to a layer's backing being retired/reused across TWO relocations of the SAME layer, not relocation in general.
